page.overview:
What is Honeyfill Meadworks?

Honeyfill Meadworks is a bee farm and estate owned by Holofernes Meiersdorf and his sons, a clan of rich halflings, and is located on the outskirts of Novigrad and west of Dancing Windmill.

It is said that whoever has not tasted their mead has never known true pleasure. This beverage is proudly served in all the best guest houses of the North and a priest is said to have once called upon it in a theological dispute, arguing that if vile halflings can create a beverage this divine, it must mean good can, in fact, be born of evil.

They had trouble with a strange creature, the one they dubbed The Apiarian Phantom, who destroyed bee farms and killed a farmhand in .
